_what: Brief 5 D1a (T4 rungs) API resolution. FILLs the 'header:line' the brief levers table demanded before use. Resolved from the REFLECTED Python surface (LandscapeLab/Intermediate/PythonStub/unreal.py, generated by this editor 2026-09-21 22:58) per the ue-api-resolution skill order; the stub is the generated reflection of the running editor, so signatures are the contract. Struct FIELDS also resolved from the stub. Two runtime behaviours are marked SELF_VERIFY: the build payload asserts them via read-back (rule 12/13), it does not assume them.

set_lod_reduction_settings.sig: set_lod_reduction_settings(static_mesh: StaticMesh, lod_index: int, reduction_options: MeshReductionSettings) -> None
set_lod_reduction_settings.use: Reduce one LOD in place. To make a rung reduced FROM LOD G, set MeshReductionSettings.base_lod_model = G_index.

set_lod_from_static_mesh.sig: set_lod_from_static_mesh(destination_static_mesh, destination_lod_index, source_static_mesh, source_lod_index, reuse_existing_material_slots: bool) -> int
set_lod_from_static_mesh.use: Copy a source LOD mesh into dest at destination_lod_index. Returns the INDEX of the LOD that was set; a NEGATIVE return means the LOD was NOT set (stub :677643) -- corrected per audit MINOR-3, was mis-stated as 'resulting lod count'. Used to assemble the final chain and preserve the AUTHORED card LOD (copied from the original mesh, not decimated). The build gates ret_index >= 0 after every call.
set_lod_from_static_mesh.SELF_VERIFY: grow-vs-replace: dest_lod_index == current count is assumed to APPEND (grow); dest_lod_index < count is assumed to REPLACE. The build reads get_lod_count()/get_number_verts() after every call and asserts the expected chain; if the assumption is wrong the assert fails loudly rather than shipping a wrong chain.

set_lods.NOT_USED: Regenerates the WHOLE chain from LOD0 (reduction_settings[0] IS LOD0 -- casualty list). Would decimate away the authored billboard card. FORBIDDEN on real meshes per FOR_CLAUDE_CODE.md:31; not used even on scratch here because it cannot preserve the authored card.

set_lod_screen_sizes.use: Set the proposed.screen_sizes after the chain is assembled. Persist per r1_persist protocol.

get_number_verts.use: Read-back rung tris/verts per LOD after each op (the gate instrument for chain correctness).

get_lod_count.use: Read-back chain length after each op.

fields_used.base_lod_model: int32 -- the LOD to reduce FROM. Set = G_index (the brief's 'base LOD = G').
fields_used.percent_triangles: float alt criterion; not used (triangle-count target is exact-intent).

MeshReductionSettings.achieved_tris_note: Reducer will not hit target exactly; make_mesh_lods.py uses COUNT_TOLERANCE=0.35. The gate is VISUAL (coverage ratio + silhouette IoU), not exact tris; achieved tris are recorded, not gated.

StaticMeshReductionSettings.fields: percent_triangles + screen_size; the per-LOD element of the whole-chain path; not used.

SpruceSapling.note: no card LOD, no rungs (derived_ladder new_rungs empty). Excluded from D1a.

gate.definition: FOR_CLAUDE_CODE.md:88-91 -- render each rung against LOD G in isolation at the rung's engage distance, judge camera 3840x2160 / 90 deg hFOV; PASS if canopy coverage ratio in [0.90,1.10] AND silhouette IoU >= 0.85 (Brief 1 lod_silhouette_check registered threshold, BRIEF.md:50-51). A failed rung is DROPPED (previous LOD holds), never shipped.
gate.output: research/brief5/input/t4_scratch_gates.json -- one PASS/FAIL row per (species,rung) with coverage_ratio, iou, achieved_tris, engage_m.

per_species: 2. for each rung: duplicate real -> throwaway; set_lod_reduction_settings(throwaway, G_index, MeshReductionSettings(base_lod_model=G_index, TRIANGLES, max_num_of_triangles=target)); read back get_number_verts(throwaway,G_index) = achieved rung tris.

3. assemble gate mesh via set_lod_from_static_mesh: replace the card slot with rung1, append rung2, append the authored card (copied from the REAL mesh card_src_lod). Assert get_lod_count + get_number_verts per idx after each call.
5. cold-readback in a distinct PID: chain tris + screen sizes match target within tol.
build_plan.fence: SCRATCH ONLY (/Game/Scratch/T4). Shipped meshes (ScotsPineTall_01, spruce_half_01) and _SRC dupes UNTOUCHED in D1a. Scratch is gitignored. Cleanup deletes /Game/Scratch/T4 after gating (item8_cleanup pattern). D1 (separate) applies only PASS rungs to the shipped meshes.
